_comment_1: REFERENCE ONLY — adapt paths and domains to your project before copying to .claude/settings.local.json
_comment_2: Permissions use a three-tier model: allow (auto-approved), deny (blocked), ask (prompted). Paths in neither allow nor deny trigger an interactive approval prompt — this is the 'ask' tier.

permissions._comment_bash_allow: Bash allowlist uses permission-rule syntax (Bash(...)) — not tools.bash.allowList. The task * entry below auto-approves any `task <name>` invocation without prompting.

_comment_3: Paths intentionally omitted from both allow and deny (ask tier): Taskfile.yml, taskfiles/*, CLAUDE.md, AGENT.md, GEMINI.md, .github/**, tsconfig.json. These trigger an interactive prompt so the user can approve or reject case-by-case.
